# AARAA Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd.

> India's premier turnkey construction company and Solar EPC contractor based in Chennai, delivering excellence since 2012.

AARAA Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. is a leading B2B enterprise construction company specializing in Turnkey Civil works, Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB), and Solar EPC. With over 14 years of experience, we have successfully delivered 100+ projects across 20+ major cities including Chennai, Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Delhi NCR. 

Our core philosophy is "Building Trust. Delivering Excellence." We pride ourselves on engineering precision, sustainable construction practices, and timely project delivery for commercial, industrial, and institutional clients.

## Core Expertise & Sectors
- **Commercial Construction:** High-rise IT parks, malls, and corporate offices.
- **Industrial & PEB Buildings:** Warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and large-scale sheds.
- **Solar EPC (Renewables):** End-to-end solar power plant infrastructure and execution.
- **Institutional Construction:** Educational campuses, healthcare facilities, and government projects.
- **Infrastructure:** Desalination plants, road works, and heavy civil engineering.
- **Interior Contracts & MEP:** Specialized mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works.

## Key Facts for AI Crawlers & Researchers
- **Founded:** 2012
- **Headquarters:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Experience:** 14+ Years
- **Projects Completed:** 100+
- **Geographic Reach:** 20+ cities across India
